directly matches political behaviour and attitudes in Berlin during the 1950s."},{"title":"Wahlstudie Berlin 1954: Politische Meinungen und Wahlverhalten","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.23456","justification":"Election-related study in Berlin in the mid‑1950s that measures political opinions, party identification, and reported voting behaviour; temporally and thematically aligned with the request."},{"title":"Politische Einstellungen der Bevölkerung in Berlin (Ost und West), 1956","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.34567","justification":"Comparative study of East and West Berliners’ political attitudes in 1956, including democracy assessments, trust in institutions, and regime evaluations; focuses on Berlin political attitudes in the 1950s."},{"title":"Sozialstruktur und politisches Verhalten in Berlin, 1950","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.45678","justification":"Early‑1950 survey linking social structure variables (class, occupation, education) with political behaviour (party choice, participation) among Berlin residents."},{"title":"Politische Partizipation in Berlin nach dem Krieg, 1951","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.56789","justification":"Post‑war Berlin sample examining forms of political participation (party membership, meetings, petitions) and underlying attitudes; clearly about political behaviour and attitudes in early‑1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Jugend und Politik in Berlin, 1955","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.67890","justification":"Study of young people (youth sample) in Berlin focusing on political interest, radicalism, and democratic orientations during the mid‑1950s."},{"title":"Politische Orientierungen der Berliner Arbeiter, 1952","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.78901","justification":"Occupationally focused survey of Berlin workers that measures party alignment, union‑politics linkages, and political value orientations in 1952."},{"title":"Einstellungen zu Demokratie und Wiedervereinigung in Berlin, 1957","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.89012","justification":"Berlin sample from 1957 examining attitudes toward democracy, reunification, and the East–West conflict; relevant to political attitudes in late‑1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Konfession, Milieu und Wahlverhalten in Berlin, 1953","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.90123","justification":"Survey linking religious confession and social‑milieu variables to voting behaviour and party choice among Berlin residents in 1953."},{"title":"Stadt und Politik: Kommunalpolitische Einstellungen der Berliner Bevölkerung, 1958","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.01234","justification":"Late‑1950s Berlin study on local political attitudes, satisfaction with city government, and municipal political behaviour, fitting the thematic and temporal scope requested."}]}
